text: The software component Volcano functions as a Kubernetes-native batch scheduling system. In versions released prior to v1.14.2, v1.13.3, and v1.12.4, the Volcano webhook server component does not establish or enforce any restriction regarding the size limit of incoming HTTP request bodies received by the service. As a consequence of this absence of size restriction, any pod situated in-cluster that possesses network reachability to the webhook endpoint may transmit an arbitrarily large request body, potentially causing the webhook server process to be killed by OOM.
